text: Another of our references. The excellent work of the architects and the investors' vision breathed new life into the Jurkovic Heating Plant as coworking spaces, a restaurant, and a cafe. Investments reached nearly 12 million EUR. The building offers more than 5,000 m2 of office space. We supplied over 1,500 m2 of insulation for HVAC and several kilometers of insulation for chilled-water distribution
